DetectionEvent.description:
One consolidated detection event at the requested decision threshold.

``scientific_name``, ``common_name`` and ``taxon`` are the species the event
counts under: the model's label, or the reviewer's correction when an event
was corrected to a label the models know. ``detected_*`` always hold the
model's own label, so a correction never hides what the model said.

counted_in_metrics.description: True when the event is in the counted set behind species, metrics and charts: a wildlife taxon, not rejected, and not flagged unlikely unless a reviewer accepted or corrected it.
counted_in_metrics.title: Counted In Metrics

detected_scientific_name.description: The model's label for this event.
detected_scientific_name.title: Detected Scientific Name

max_confidence.description: Model score for the detected label.
max_confidence.title: Max Confidence

plausibility.description: Range and season check of the detected label; reviews do not change it.
plausibility.title: Plausibility

scientific_name.description: Species the event counts under (see detected_*).
scientific_name.title: Scientific Name
